note: What actually ran, as recorded from the commands and their logs. Wall seconds are `date +%s` differences around the `boltz predict` process; the GPU figure is the whole device's used memory sampled every 0.4 s by `nvidia-smi`, so it includes the ~0.9 GiB the desktop compositor holds.

predictors_installed.proteinmpnn: .local/tools/ProteinMPNN — inverse folding, not a structure predictor; not run

sequences.note: Extracted from the authenticated M5 mmCIF files' own `_atom_site` rows, never retyped. Identical in all three reference presentations.

runs.name: boltz2-target-seed0
runs.msa_mode: colabfold MMseqs2 server (https://api.colabfold.com), unpaired; single chain so no pairing is involved

runs.name: boltz2-complex-seed0
runs.msa_mode: colabfold MMseqs2 server, greedy pairing; the target chain received a real paired+unpaired MSA and the de novo binder a single-sequence MSA, because the server found no homolog of a designed sequence
runs.failure: Two attempts before this one died in `boltz/data/msa/mmseqs2.py::run_mmseqs2` with `tarfile.ReadError: not a gzip file`. The file the server returned is JSON: {"message":"Route GET:/compute/v1/msa/result/download/<hash> not found","error":"Not Found","statusCode":404}. The 404 is intermittent and hits the paired or the unpaired download arbitrarily; boltz 2.2.1 does not check the HTTP status before handing the body to `tarfile.open`. Retrying is the whole workaround.

runs.name: boltz2-complex-seed1
runs.msa_mode: the seed-0 run's own emitted MSA csv files, named per chain in the FASTA header; no server call, so the MSA is byte-identical to the seed-0 run and the only difference is the seed

runs.name: boltz2-target-seed1
runs.msa_mode: the seed-0 target run's own emitted MSA csv; no server call

runs.name: gpu-memory-probe
runs.command: boltz predict inputs/binder-target-seed1.fasta --out_dir <scratch> --seed 1 --output_format mmcif --write_full_pae --override, with `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used` sampled every 0.4 s
runs.purpose: peak device memory of the 204-token complex; the prediction itself is a repeat of boltz2-complex-seed1
